hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM backed by Euler Protocol vaults. All swap logic executes in beforeSwap using a custom concentrated liquidity curve, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults. It blocks standard liquidity additions, donations, and unauthorized pool initializations to enforce its custom curve invariant.
